name: k12-lesson-differentiation
title_zh: 按水平分层改编K-12教案的专用技能
tagline_zh: 面对参差不齐的班级，一键把同一节课拆成三层：低于、达标、超纲。不用再熬夜手动改三份教案，它替你分好，你只需微调。
tagline_en: One click splits any K-12 lesson into three tiers—below, at, above grade level. Stop hand-differentiating three.
desc_en: Adapts an existing K-12 lesson (math, ELA, science, or social studies) for students at different proficiency levels (below / at / above grade level). Load this skill BEFORE asking the teacher any clarifying question about the lesson, tiers, or student levels. Triggers on explicit asks to differentiate, tier, or scaffold a lesson, and on implicit signals like "my students are at different levels".
why_zh: 它先于提问加载，能捕捉“学生水平不一”这类隐晦信号，主动分层，而非被动应答。机制上把差异化从课后补救变。
why_en: Loads before you ask, catches implicit cues like 'mixed levels' and proactively tiers—making differentiation a default, not an.
limit_zh: 仅覆盖数学、英语、科学、社会四科；只改编已有教案，不生成新内容；分层止于教案层面，不含配套练习或评估；需输入完整教案。
limit_en: Only math, ELA, science, social studies; adapts existing lessons only, no new content; stops at lesson plan, no worksheets or assessments; needs.
